scope: All 14 class starters named by the cached Plane of Sky Quests (Old) page, joined through exact NPC ID -> spawnentry -> dedicated spawngroup -> airplane spawn2; exclude all other room NPCs, island mobs and testers.
broadEvidenceQuote: Quest mobs have a 3 hour respawn time.
applicationRationale: The same introductory section identifies the parenthesized class names as the quest-room NPCs to hail to summon the turn-in NPC. All 14 corresponding static starters depop_with_timer when summoning. The 3-hour sentence is therefore applied to natural starter respawn, not to a spawned tester lifetime; more-specific contradictions take precedence over blanket application. For Josin, the exact NPC-page 8-hour statement is stronger and is selected explicitly.

notes: This page documents old Plane of Sky reward versions for posterity and says those old versions became impossible after P99's July 24, 2011 upgrade patch.
The implemented Plane of Sky test audit targets the current P99 class-specific Plane of Sky pages, not this historical old-reward reference page.

historicalSourceLimit.interpretation: The historical classification explicitly addresses obsolete rewards, not a fast-respawn adaptation. It is neither an actual quests exclusion nor proof that every statement on the overview is obsolete. It is not permission to restore old rewards. Non-reward respawn evidence remains a scoped interpretation; Josin's exact NPC description takes precedence for his duration.

runtimeUnits.variance: uniform plus/minus seconds; zero stays zero
runtimeUnits.evidence: Coordinator verified current game downstream population service uses seconds-based timer behavior and uniform +/- variance.
runtimeUnits.verificationLimit: Current-game verification supplied by coordinating audit; this bounded subreview did not access another checkout.

questDepopEvidence.fact: depop_with_timer captures WithTimer: true; the existing starters retain this call.

specificConflict.quote: His respawn time is 8 hours, making it impossible to complete back to back turn-in sky quests.
specificConflict.decision: Use the more-specific, exact Josin NPC description: 28,800 seconds for spawn2 2697/group 5482. Preserve the broader 3-hour disagreement in evidence. A newer dated source or direct observation could change this precedence decision.

policyLimits: No fast-respawn adaptation was found in the supplied current game documentation or the cached class audit policies.

Preserve direct tester spawning and omitted book-return flow; do not edit any quest script, rewards, class gates, faction bypasses, population membership, coordinates, chance, variance, or content-scope ledger.
npc_types.exclude=1 is not a whole-script ban: all 14 effective quest keys are enabled; none appears in content_exclusions.json.quests or exact/pattern NPC exclusion policy.

Spawned tester Lua timers use milliseconds. A five-minute (300,000ms) tester lifetime is not a 300-second or 300,000-second static starter respawn. The Fiery Avenger specifically documents Dirkog and Inte Akera despawning after five minutes; preserve them.
The general page does not independently give exact per-NPC timer measurements or date/revision changes. Josin demonstrates that generalizing without specific-page checks would be unsafe.
No baseline sources, data, reference files or manifest changed. No SQL apply, production mutation, commit, push, PR, merge or deploy.
